_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment + ADR-022 (link-don't-store / consume OR + NC abstractions) + ADR-031 (declarative business logic) — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2 — Generic Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM). Declares Contract + ContractObligation schemas with x-openregister-audit-trail, x-openregister-lifecycle (draft → active → expiring → expired with renewed/terminated exits), x-openregister-calculations (renewalDecisionDate = endDate − renewalTerms.noticePeriodDays), and x-openregister-notifications (canonical ADR-031 dialect; lands the contract-renewal rule deferred by shillinq-notifications). Counterparty is an NC addressbook contact reference (no Party/Customer schema). Documents/evidence are NC Files references (link, don't store). The committed-vs-invoiced spend rollup is CHAINED behind bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way / add-shillinq-accounts-payable-core / add-shillinq-accounts-receivable-core: it is documented as an x-chained-aggregations note here and intentionally declares NO active aggregation rules targeting absent schemas, so the spend dashboard renders an honest empty state until those schemas land. Lease contracts become a specialization by link via specializationReference → LeaseContract (no regression to the IFRS 16 lease suite). Seed data ships demo contracts + obligations clearly marked as demo.

Contract.title: Contract
Contract.description: Generic contract master record covering every contract type (purchase, sales, service, subscription, lease, employment, other). CRUD goes through OpenRegister's generic object surface (ADR-022) — no custom PHP model, no parallel table. The counterparty is referenced as a Nextcloud addressbook contact (counterpartyReference); no Party/Customer/Supplier schema is invented. Renewal terms are an embedded object (D3); renewalDecisionDate is a declared calculation. Documents are NC Files references (link, don't store). Lease contracts become a specialization by link via specializationReference → LeaseContract; generic records never duplicate lease accounting fields. Lifecycle and notifications are declarative.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Contract repository register; every create / update / lifecycle transition (activate / markExpiring / expire / terminate / renew) is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel + ADR-022. The audit trail is the canonical evidence chain for renewal and termination decisions.

renewalType.description: How the contract renews at term end.
renewalType.title: Renewal Type

renewalTermMonths.description: Length of each renewal term in months; carried forward to the successor draft on renew.
renewalTermMonths.title: Renewal Term Months

noticePeriodDays.description: Notice period before endDate; renewalDecisionDate = endDate − noticePeriodDays.
noticePeriodDays.title: Notice Period Days

priceIndexation.example: CBS CPI alle huishoudens, jaarlijks per 1 januari

renewalTerms.title: Renewal Terms

totalContractValue.title: Total Contract Value

dimensionRef.description: FK to the dimension value record.
dimensionRef.title: Dimension Ref

dimensions.title: Dimensions

path.description: Display path of the linked file in NC Files.
path.title: Path

documents.title: Documents

terminationReason.description: Operator-authored reason for termination. Mandatory on the terminate transition (fail-closed guard).
terminationReason.example: Opgezegd binnen opzegtermijn wegens herinrichting facilitair contractbeheer.
terminationReason.title: Termination Reason

predecessorContract.description: Self-FK to the predecessor Contract in a renewal chain. Set on the successor draft created by the renew transition.
predecessorContract.title: Predecessor Contract

successorContract.description: Self-FK to the successor Contract in a renewal chain. Set on this record by the renew transition.
successorContract.title: Successor Contract

specializationReference.description: FK to a specialized register record (e.g. a LeaseContract for contractType=lease). The generic record links the specialization; it never duplicates the specialized accounting fields.
specializationReference.title: Specialization Reference

tags.description: Free-form repository facets for filtering and OR _search.
tags.title: Tags

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this contract record. Resolved server-side; never accepted from the client.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Governance decisions (board/AV adoption, approvals) for this contract. References decidesk Decision objects (ADR-066); Decidesk owns the making and eIDAS signing.

renewalDecisionDate.description: Computed renewal/notice decision date: endDate minus renewalTerms.noticePeriodDays. Declared so the scheduled renewal notification rule and the repository 'decide by' column read one real field (no PHP recomputation service).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Being negotiated; incomplete fields allowed. Not yet in force.

active.label: Active
active.description: In force. Required fields complete and start date reached.

expiring.label: Expiring
expiring.description: Inside the notice / renewal-decision window (today >= renewalDecisionDate). Renewal or termination decision pending.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: End date passed without renewal. Terminal unless renewed.

renewed.label: Renewed
renewed.description: Renewed into a linked successor draft contract. Terminal for this record; the chain continues on the successor.

terminated.label: Terminated
terminated.description: Ended early with a recorded termination reason. Terminal state.

activate.label: Activate contract
activate.description: Put the contract in force. Guard: startDate, counterpartyReference, and contractOwner must all be present.
activate.x-adr-031-exception: Cross-field non-empty precondition over startDate + counterpartyReference + contractOwner is not yet expressible as a single declarative requires clause; single-method fail-closed guard per ADR-031 §'PHP guards remain a legitimate seam'. Replace with a declarative condition when the lifecycle DSL supports multi-field required guards.

markExpiring.label: Mark expiring
markExpiring.description: Time-based transition: fires when today >= renewalDecisionDate. Evaluated by OR's scheduled lifecycle machinery (ADR-031 path 2) — NOT a shillinq cron/Job class.

x-scheduled-workflow.description: Daily 01:00 sweep transitions active → expiring when today >= renewalDecisionDate. The renewal-decision notification (rule 1) filters on renewalDecisionDate directly, so the notification SLA never depends on this flip having happened.

expire.label: Expire
expire.description: Time-based transition: fires when today > endDate and no renewal was executed. Evaluated by OR's scheduled lifecycle machinery (ADR-031 path 2).

x-scheduled-workflow.description: Daily 01:00 sweep transitions active|expiring → expired when today > endDate and status is not renewed/terminated.

terminate.label: Terminate contract
terminate.description: End the contract early. Guard: terminationReason must be present (fail-closed).
terminate.x-adr-031-exception: The 'terminated requires terminationReason' precondition is a conditional-required field the declarative lifecycle DSL cannot yet express inside a requires clause; single-method fail-closed guard per ADR-031. Replace when the DSL supports conditional-required guards.

renew.label: Renew contract
renew.description: Renew the contract. Creates a linked successor Contract in draft carrying the renewal terms forward (startDate = predecessor endDate + 1 day, term = renewalTerms.renewalTermMonths), and sets predecessorContract / successorContract self-FKs on both records.

subject.en: Renewal decision due for contract {{contractNumber}} — {{title}} (decide by {{renewalDecisionDate}})

x-chained-aggregations._chained: REQ-CLM-006 spend rollup is CHAINED behind unmerged schemas. NO active x-openregister-aggregations rules are declared here, on purpose, to keep the fragment honest: no aggregation may target a schema that does not yet exist (gate cleanliness). The spend dashboard renders an explicit 'no linked spend data' empty state until the chained schemas land.

committedSpend.description: DEFERRED — sum of PurchaseOrder totals where contractReference = this contract. Activated only once bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way lands its PurchaseOrder schema and adds the optional contractReference FK. Until then: honest empty state, no rule, no FK invented here.

invoicedSpend.description: DEFERRED — direction-aware: for direction=inbound sum APInvoice totals with contractReference = this; for direction=outbound sum ARInvoice totals with contractReference = this. Activated only once add-shillinq-accounts-payable-core / add-shillinq-accounts-receivable-core land their schemas and add the optional contractReference FK. Until then: honest empty state, no rule, no FK invented here.
invoicedSpend.deferredAggregate: sum(totalAmount) where contractReference = this (AP for inbound, AR for outbound)

ContractObligation.title: Contract Obligation
ContractObligation.description: Deadline-bearing obligation row owned by a Contract. The register row is the source of truth for the deadline and compliance status; the actionable to-do lives in NC Tasks (CalDAV VTODO) or a Deck card, created and linked by ObligationTaskBridge (taskUri). Evidence files are NC Files references (link, don't store). Shillinq declares NO task/todo schema of its own (ADR-022 / 'content types belong in leaves'). Deadline notifications fire from the OR notification engine on this row, so a deleted NC task never silences a deadline.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Contract-obligation register; every create / update / status change is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel + ADR-022.
